title: Decoupled Financial Architecture
description: Modular platform designed for independent evolution of the financial engine and the client layer. Focused on clean domain boundaries, observability, and long-term maintainability.
imageAlt: Cover for the Decoupled Financial Architecture case study, showing an aggregated balance chart and the tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, React, Docker, PostgreSQL.

title: Arquitectura Financiera Desacoplada
description: Plataforma modular diseñada para la evolución independiente del motor financiero y la capa de cliente. Enfocada en límites de dominio limpios, observabilidad y mantenibilidad a largo plazo.
imageAlt: Portada del caso de estudio de Arquitectura Financiera Desacoplada, con un gráfico de saldo agregado y el stack: Java, Spring Boot, React, Docker, PostgreSQL.
